chunks: And from him, from al-‘Abbās ibn Ma‘rūf, from al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb, from ‘Alī ibn Ri’āb, from Ziyād ibn Sūqah, from Abī Ja‘far عليه السلام, who said:
“There is no harm in one of you performing salat (prayer) in a single garment while its buttons are undone. Indeed, the religion of Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله is upright and inclining to truth.”

key_terms.حَنِيفٌ: upright, inclining away from falsehood toward truth
key_terms.دِينُ مُحَمَّدٍ: the religion brought by Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or objection

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to pray in one garment with the buttons undone?
ai.summary: This hadith states that it is permissible to perform salat (prayer) in a single garment even if its buttons are undone. It frames this ease within the upright and natural character of the religion of Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله.
